【锐利：命中敌人时造成额外一点伤害】

-----------------
-----------------

【默咏剑舞（初级）：你掌握了基本的剑术概念。1.法术失败率降低10%。2.你能在战斗中开启剑舞，身体协调能力增加的同时使移动速度增加20%，且能够根据智力增加防御以及攻击的伤害和准确度，无法在穿着重甲时开启】

[Sharp: Causes an extra point of damage when hitting an enemy]

------------------
[Not afraid of the cold: You can activate the effect to completely immune to the next cold damage suffered, once a day]
[Cold-blooded creature: The user will be immune to a series of negative effects caused by cold when moving in cold areas]
[Spell Attachment: The user can use the trick "Water Manipulation"]
[Spell Penetration: All spells that can cause damage have +1 damage]
------------------
[Combat Spellcaster]: Casting failure rate -10%. The next time you cast a melee spell, the damage caused by the spell will be the highest value, once a day.
[Death Resistance]: When the holder is seriously injured, within one minute, running speed increases by 30%, defense +2, attacks and spells cause an additional 2 points of damage, once a day
[Attack Prediction]: You can briefly predict the enemy's next move. The prediction time increases with the increase of "Intelligence".
[Blade Spell Specialization]: 1. The maximum damage of spells cast using blades such as "Emerald Flame Sword" is increased by two points. 2. After the spell ends, you can choose to cancel the damage to other units and attach the flame to the sword blade. At this time, the weapon attack will cause an additional two points of damage, lasting for 18 seconds, and can be used three times a day.
[Silent Sword Dance (Elementary): You have mastered the basic concepts of swordsmanship. 1. The spell failure rate is reduced by 10%. 2. You can turn on the sword dance during battle, which will increase your physical coordination and increase your movement speed by 20%. You can also increase the damage and accuracy of defense and attack based on your intelligence. It cannot be turned on while wearing heavy armor]
